From the text, take 7 houses north of Straße A and 5 houses south of Straße A, so these two sides together account for all houses: 7 + 5 = 12. The text also says 8 houses are east of Straße B. Since Straße B splits the same total set into east and west, houses west of Straße B are 12 - 8 = 4.
